children: announced a non-brokered private placement offering to raise gross proceeds of up to C$250K.

The financing consists of up to 1.67M units priced at C$0.15 per unit. Each unit comprises one common share and one transferable purchase warrant, which entitles the holder to acquire an additional common share at C$0.175 for a period of 24 months from issuance.
Net proceeds from the placement will be used for general corporate purposes, including the settlement of arm’s-length payables.
The offering remains subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals from the Canadian Securities Exchange.
All securities issued will be subject to a statutory four-month-and-one-day hold period under applicable securities laws, and finder's fees may apply in connection with the transaction.
